title: Crash near `EditorPropertyResource::fold_resource()` on switching from selected tile in TileSet editor
body:
### Tested versions

- 4.7.1.stable.nixpkgs.a13da4feb



### System information

Nixos 25.11

### Issue description

I ran into this error when working on a project. 

Whenever I tried to open my tileset and make changes to the tiles using the 'select' mode in the TileSet editor, as soon as I switched over from one tile to another, this crash occurred.
This crash occurred multiple times, each time at that very same step.

I was able to resolve the error by removing the `.godot` directory, which leads me to believe it's some problem with the editor cache.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Select a `TileMapLayer`
2. Go to the `TileSet` tab.
3. Go to 'select' mode.
4. Click one tile in the tileset.
5. Click another tile in the tileset (with or without adjusting the tile data).


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Problematic, I can't reproduce this bug, as it involves the editor cache, and after deleting and rebuilding the `.godot` directory in my project this bug doesn't occur anymore, but wanted to report it anyway in case the backtrace is telling.

Feel free to close this issue if it's impossible to track down.

I have backed up the specific problematic `.godot` directory before rebuilding it, in case someone wants to investigate further.
